clean_description: In 'Childhood's End', alien Overlords arrive on Earth, bringing an era of peace and prosperity while secretly guiding humanity toward a predetermined evolution. As the Overlords eliminate conflict and suffering, human culture stagnates, revealing the darker implications of their seemingly benevolent rule. Ultimately, the true purpose of the Overlords becomes apparent, raising questions about the future of humanity.
themes: human evolution, utopia vs dystopia, the nature of progress
